rundown: Tigers beat Lions 5-1 at Gene Polisseni Center in Rochester, NY. Tigers led 3-0 after two periods and never looked back. The 1st period decided it: Tigers won it 2-0.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 12:59 PM ET. It had Lions 41% and Tigers 59%, projecting Lions 2.6 – Tigers 3.1 (5.6 total, Tigers by 0.5).

Final: Lions 1 – Tigers 5. Right winner: it had Tigers at 59%.

Thin data: 0 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: LIN goals scored, LIN goals allowed, LIN lineup rating or past seasons, RIT goals scored, RIT goals allowed, RIT lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Lions came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 20 and 21 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.6, they scored 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under); projected to allow 3.1, they allowed 5 (+1.9 goals, 63% over).

Tigers came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 21 and 20 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.1, they scored 5 (+1.9 goals, 63% over); projected to allow 2.6, they allowed 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under).

The bigger miss was Tigers' scoring (+1.9 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 6 against 5.6 projected (+0.4), about the 56th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.4).

Margin: Tigers by 4 against Tigers by 0.5 projected, about the 92nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.4).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.body:

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.001 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +3.3 goals. It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 96 graded Hockey+ games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Lions attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (5 games); Tigers attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 3.5 goals), no bet.
